summary: The first bounded pass on the new root resolves Katherine Hsiao as the direct Palantir-personnel publication link into WEF Data Equity work. No second Palantir employee was resolved from the reviewed WEF Data Equity publication/profile surfaces.

gaps: The official WEF-hosted 2023 and 2024 PDFs remain unrecovered in this environment.

data.question: Which Palantir personnel are directly named in WEF Data Equity publication/council surfaces?
data.method: Crossmatch WEF publication/index pages and authoritative paper metadata against Palantir personnel names already present in the corpus.
findings: Katherine Hsiao is directly listed among the authors of the 2023 WEF Data Equity briefing paper in arXiv metadata.
WEF's current publication index lists both the 2023 foundational Data Equity paper and the 2024 Advancing Data Equity framework as Data Equity council outputs.
WEF's 2024 publication page states that Advancing Data Equity was produced by members of the Global Future Council on Data Equity, but the HTML page does not list individual contributors.
No second Palantir employee was resolved from the reviewed public WEF Data Equity publication/profile surfaces in this pass.
conclusions: Hsiao is the strongest and currently sole direct Palantir-personnel bridge into the reviewed WEF Data Equity output network.
limitations: PDF contributor pages remain a coverage gap until the new collector can retrieve them.
